# Upstream License Notice

Etalon is an independent project founded and maintained by Timothy Charles Holborn.
Its starting source was a fork of the wgpu snapshot at
[`e084b66aab767940ff1236604d194c9e1c2844b0`](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu/tree/e084b66aab767940ff1236604d194c9e1c2844b0),
whose workspace declared version `30.0.0`. The fork was taken under the MIT
licence before the updates that began creating Etalon on 20 October 2026.
Some graphics, validation and shader-compiler foundations, including Naga,
originated in that snapshot, authored by the gfx-rs developers and contributors.
These credits describe the inherited material's authorship; they do not identify
the contributors or maintainers of the independent Etalon project.

### Etalon modifications and additions

Development from that snapshot established Etalon as a distinct project for the
Webizen and Qualia ecosystems. It includes improvements to inherited functions
and substantial new libraries and systems outside wgpu's original scope.
